legalName: Connecticut absolute-pardon application resulting in erasure under C.G.S. Sec. 54-142a(d)
routeSelectionNote: The exact route is fixed as obligation:track-pathway:CT:ct-absolute-pardon:absolute-pardon-resulting-in-erasure. The guide selects that agency route and presents no alternate instrument for the participant to elect.
